preserved_invariants: frozen W0-W18 semantics and every merged package/app/test untouched; only the four owned paths are created

leases are granted/renewed/revoked through the P9 action-gateway body-lifecycle family with action-time CURRENT authority re-evaluation; a revoked/expired/never-held grant fails closed as a typed denial and execution stops (never a bypass)
SUSPECTED is not LOST: a missed beat is truthful UNKNOWN (the body may be alive) and ONLY a verified failure observation transitions to LOST — death is never fabricated
checkpoints are content-addressed and fail-closed: a corrupted or tampered checkpoint is a typed CHECKPOINT_INVALID denial, never silently re-derived
a task resumed from a verified checkpoint continues the SAME P6 work graph from the checkpointed step — never a silent restart, never skipped verification, never fabricated progress
body replacement preserves task/artifact identity; in-flight side effects are reconciled from the durable store, never assumed; the honestly UNKNOWN is carried as unresolved uncertainty
cancellation is first-class and durable: a cancelled task stays cancelled across body replacement and emits the P9 action evidence chain

provider outages are typed windows with truthful UNAVAILABLE statuses — never silent retry storms; recovery follows bounded fixed-schedule backoff with typed retry records, then ASK when bounds are exhausted (never an infinite loop)
cost/resource accounting appends typed episodes to the durable task record — evidence, never an enforcement authority
the task timeline is a derived replayable view of the durable observation log — never a second source of truth
no self-approval: the task runtime never certifies completion; the independent verification record gates the COMPLETED transition

zero new external dependencies (workspace:* + the existing toolchain only); pnpm-lock.yaml and pnpm-workspace.yaml unchanged; offline determinism outside the documented apps/task-runner composition boundary
boundary_changes: packages/autonomy-runtime: new leaf workspace member importing only @sos-2/action-gateway, @sos-2/live-store and @sos-2/semantic-spine (all merged at base); consumed only by packages/task-runtime, apps/task-runner and tests/autonomy
